snippet.title: Nintendogs Deluxe | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://aurumsmods.com/ndogdeluxe/
Nintendogs Deluxe is an unofficial patch for all first-generation Nintendogs games. It was created as a self-imposed challenge to develop a small mod within only seven days. Fittingly for the original game's 20th anniversary, I thought that revisiting one of Nintendo's most iconic games would make for an interesting detour from my usual work. The mod provides an enhanced yet faithful way to replay the original Nintendogs by creating a single game that includes the content from all versions such that no external needs are necessary to complete the entire game.

- The cut Afro Wig accessory has been fully restored.
- All version-exclusive items are now available within a single game.
- The event-exclusive Pair of Star Sunglasses may be found during walks.
- The trainer point restriction for finding specific items has been removed.
- Some items are now only available in shops.
- All cover breeds from the original games are available at the start.
- The unlocking criteria for all breeds and interior styles have been changed.
- A completely new title screen has been created.
- Updated and modernized all localizations.

The awesome Nintendogs medley used in this video was created by NoteBlock and Scruffy. Check out the full track here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jtfsuyhC5f4
